1. 'I'm lowkey nervous about the presentation.' This can be spelled out as 'I am secretly/quietly nervous about the presentation.'
2. 'She's lowkey the best student in the class.' This translates to 'She is secretly/quietly the best student in the class.'
3. 'He's highkey showing off with his new car.' This can be written as 'He is openly/obviously showing off with his new car.'
4. 'The professor is highkey tough.' This translates to 'The professor is openly/obviously tough.'
5. 'They're highkey dating, but they deny it.' This can be spelled out as 'They are openly/obviously dating, but they deny it.'
